cases.name: valid_holdout_chain
cases.why: the golden holdout chain verifies, held-out receipts included

cases.name: reorder
cases.why: seq 1 then seq 0 in one batch: 1 accepted with a gap, 0 refused

cases.name: gap
cases.why: seq 1 missing: reported, chain resumes at 2

cases.name: late_predecessor
cases.why: seq 1 arrives in a later batch and links both ways

cases.name: late_predecessor_forward_break
cases.why: a later seq 1 links back to 0 but is not the receipt seq 2 names

cases.name: duplicate_seq
cases.why: a second, differently-identified receipt at seq 0

cases.name: replay_next_batch
cases.why: the same receipt uploaded again in a later batch

cases.name: chain_break
cases.why: seq 1 links to the wrong predecessor

cases.name: cross_cert_replay
cases.why: a receipt presented under another workload's certificate

cases.name: protojson_receipt
cases.why: protojson form of Receipt (camelCase, zero values dropped, uint64 strings)

cases.name: cert_length_overrun
cases.why: tenant length prefix runs past the end

cases.name: cert_bad_domain
cases.why: certificate domain is the receipt domain

note: each case runs its batches in order against one fresh verifier holding pinned_cp_keys
